summary: Non-root scopes could be created with Range == null when AST Provenance.Range is null.
fix: Added ToSourceRange(Provenance) helper that synthesises a degenerate single-character SourceRange from Line+Column when p.Range is null. Used at all four non-root scope construction sites. Added NonRootScopes_HaveNonNullRangeEvenWhenAstProvenanceRangeIsNull test.

summary: Declare/Event parameters had Scope=ModuleScope set without being registered in ModuleScope.Declarations, breaking the bidirectional ownership invariant.
fix: Removed the manual `p.Scope = _currentModule;` loops. Declare/Event parameters now keep Scope=null. They are accessed via decl.Parameters at call sites, not via lexical scope chain. Adding them to ModuleScope.Declarations would let module-level TryFindLocal incorrectly resolve a use-site to a Declare param. Updated DeclareStatement_/EventDeclaration_ tests to assert Assert.Null(param.Scope) and Assert.DoesNotContain(param, module.Declarations).
